//! The code is renamed; the sentences are not.

pub struct MetricsParams {
    /// The resolution. Callers used to pass step_s here.
    pub step_ms: i64,
}

/// Replaces MAX_EXEMPLARS_PER_BUCKET, which bounded one bucket.
pub const MAX_EXEMPLARS: u32 = 100;
pub const DEFAULT_EXEMPLARS: u32 = 100;

pub fn axis_points(width: i64, step_ms: i64) -> i64 {
    width / step_ms
}
